C0383.title: Multiple Ningbo Professional Store Closers Sentenced for Fraud in Prepaid Consumer Scam
C0383.summary: In February 2023, Qian, Li, and others took over a struggling prepaid consumer store in Ningbo, lured consumers with low-price promotions to top up their cards, then abruptly closed the store and disappeared, absconding with large amounts of prepaid funds.
